info.title: Igloo API
info.description: HTTP API for the Igloo self-hosted media center. Most JSON endpoints return a shared envelope with error, optional message, and optional data fields. Device bearer tokens issued via Quick Connect or device login (Authorization: Bearer igd_...) are accepted on most routes that accept cookieAuth, except device-management and Quick Connect approval endpoints, which require a cookie session. See each operation's security block for route-specific requirements.

Poll a quick-connect code and receive a device token once approved
post.description: Quick Connect pairings are kept in this server process's memory. In multi-instance deployments, initiate, approve, and redeem must reach the same instance through sticky routing or a shared store; otherwise cross-instance requests can return 404. Devices poll this endpoint at the advertised interval. A 404 means the code is unknown, expired, or the secret does not match (including after a server restart); the device should request a new code and start over. Approved codes are consumed: the token is returned exactly once.

post.summary: Look up the device behind a pending quick-connect code
post.description: Returns the pending device's name, platform, and app version so the user can see what they are approving. Does not bind or consume the code. Session-authenticated users only, and it shares the approve endpoint's rate limit so lookups cannot be used to guess codes faster.

cookieAuth.name: session
cookieAuth.description: Server-side session cookie set by POST /api/auth/login.

bearerAuth.description: Long-lived device token issued by POST /api/quick-connect/redeem or POST /api/auth/device-login. Tokens are prefixed with igd_. Devices unused for 90 days are revoked automatically; the device must pair again.

StaticPath.name: path
StaticPath.description: Relative file path below the configured static directory.

HLSFilenamePath.name: filename
HLSFilenamePath.description: HLS asset name. Valid values are init.mp4 or segment_N.m4s.

TrackIndexPath.name: trackIndex
TrackIndexPath.description: Zero-based index into the movie subtitle rows ordered by stream_index.

OptionalUserSearchQuery.name: q
OptionalUserSearchQuery.description: Case-insensitive name or email substring filter.

AudioTrackQuery.name: audio_track
AudioTrackQuery.description: Zero-based audio track index. Required for movies with audio; omit for video-only movies.

StartQuery.name: start
StartQuery.description: Session start time in seconds. Values at or beyond the movie duration are normalized to five seconds before the end, or zero when the movie is shorter than five seconds; rewritten HLS asset URLs use the normalized value.

PlaybackSessionQuery.name: playback_session
PlaybackSessionQuery.description: UUID that scopes one personal HLS playback session.

HLSReloadQuery.name: reload
HLSReloadQuery.description: Opaque client-supplied value echoed into rewritten HLS asset URLs; not part of the session cache key.

SubtitleStartQuery.name: start
SubtitleStartQuery.description: HLS session start in seconds. Cues are extracted with absolute source timestamps, so they are shifted by this value to match a rebased session's media timeline. Omit for direct play and sessions starting at zero.

avatar.description: JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, or AVIF image up to 20 MB.

MessageSuccess.description: Successful JSON response with an optional message.

UserPinResponse.description: Current profile PIN for the session user.

NotificationsListResponse.description: List of notifications visible to the current user with the unread count.

UnreadNotificationCountResponse.description: Unread notification count for the current user.

X-Igloo-Effective-Profile.description: Profile FFmpeg actually ran. This differs from the requested profile in the path whenever the remux safety gate forces a transcode, so a `remux` request can be answered with a transcode profile here.

X-Igloo-Actual-Start.description: Seconds into the movie where the session's media really begins. Stream copy cannot cut mid-GOP, so a copy-video session starts at the source keyframe at or before the requested start. Omitted when it has not been measured.

HLSSegmentResponse.description: Fragmented MP4 initialization file or media segment.

PartialHLSSegmentResponse.description: Partial fragmented MP4 initialization file or media segment for a byte range.

PartialBinaryMediaResponse.description: Partial media file response for a byte range.

RangeNotSatisfiable.description: Requested byte range cannot be satisfied.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated user is not allowed to perform this action.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: Media type cannot be converted or processed.

ServiceUnavailable.description: Generated media is not ready yet or HLS session/transcode capacity is temporarily unavailable.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying when HLS capacity is unavailable.

QuickConnectRedeemResponse.description: Pairing status; includes the device token once approved.

DevicesListResponse.description: Devices belonging to the current user.

avatar.description: Avatar URL. Empty string removes the avatar.

pin.description: New 4-digit PIN. Empty string removes the PIN.

current_pin.description: Required when a PIN is already set.

pin.description: The plaintext PIN, or null when none is set.

immich_base_url.description: Optional Immich base URL. Non-null values must use http:// or https://.

jellyfin_base_url.description: Optional Jellyfin base URL. Non-null values must use http:// or https://.

immich_base_url.description: Optional Immich base URL. Blank clears the value; nonblank values must use http:// or https://.

jellyfin_base_url.description: Optional Jellyfin base URL. Blank clears the value; nonblank values must use http:// or https://.

preferred_subtitle_language.description: Two- or three-letter language code, or off.

server_upload_mbps.description: Admin-only server upload bandwidth cap in Mbps.

hardware_acceleration_device.description: Admin-only hardware acceleration device used for new transcodes.

audio_track.description: Zero-based ordinal into the movie's audio streams. Must be less than the movie's audio stream count, must be 0 for a movie without audio, and must be 0 when `mode` is `direct` because direct playback always serves the container's first audio track.

platform.description: Client platform identifier, e.g. android_tv, android, ios.

code.description: The only value to display to the user; they enter it in the web app to approve the device. Always six uppercase characters drawn from an alphabet that omits I, L, O, 0 and 1 so it stays unambiguous on a TV screen.

secret.description: Device-held secret required to redeem the code. Never shown to the user: keep it in memory and send it back in the redeem request body.

code.description: The six-character code shown on the device. Case-insensitive; surrounding whitespace, spaces and dashes are ignored.

is_current.description: True when the request was authenticated with this device's token. Always false in the device-list response, which is session-only.

token.description: Bearer device token. Present only when status is approved; returned exactly once. Store it; never display it.

code.description: The six-character code shown on the device. Case-insensitive; surrounding whitespace, spaces and dashes are ignored.

token.description: Bearer device token; returned exactly once.
